d: Long, flowing honey-blonde hair with a thick cowlick and side-swept bangs frames a youthful face with wide, bright sapphire-blue eyes. The slender build is dressed in a lime-green and charcoal-grey outfit consisting of a cropped top, a pleated mini-skirt, and a flowing cape, all accented with gold trim and white undersleeves. Pointed elf ears peek through the hair, complemented by brown calf-high boots and a large green ribbon tied at the back of the head.
